The '''1970–71 Cypriot First Division''' was the 32nd season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league.

==Overview==
It was contested by 12 teams, and [[Olympiakos Nicosia]] won the championship.  [[EPA Larnaca FC]] participated in the [[1970–71 Alpha Ethniki|Greek championship]] as the previous year's champions. They finished in 18th position.
